role: Senior Software Engineer - Distributed Systems Engineer, EDA Infrastructure
positioning: Relevant professional engineering achievements prioritized to the target opening without inflating formal level, scope or metrics.

entries.text: Senior software engineer combining production EDA and SoC interconnect software, Python backend tooling, Linux/LSF-aware cluster automation, CI qualification and hardware/software systems experience.
Arm — Senior Software Engineer | Austin, TX | April 2023–Present
Developed and maintained Arm Interconnect Architect, a customer-shipped EDA application with Angular/TypeScript and Python APIs for coherent and non-coherent interconnect configuration.
Served as CMN GUI Lead with ownership of complex mesh and port configuration, routing workflows and validation interfaces for hardware engineering users.
Contributed to shared configuration-engine Python APIs and delivered integrated desktop-to-backend engineering workflows.
Implemented safe user-scoped cluster-operating practices, including run-owned paths, ownership checks and LSF-aware resource scheduling.
Built a Jenkins/Playwright repair workflow that reconstructs failures from CI artifacts and recorded Git state, respecting LSF execution constraints.
Created qualification and Playwright infrastructure for engineering UI and renderer/persistence tests with retained artifacts and explicit completion evidence.
Introduced Pixi.js rendering optimization and repaired UI event and subscription cleanup issues in large graphical engineering canvases.
Arm — Software Engineer | Austin, TX | April 2020–April 2023
Implemented React dashboard components, Flask backend notebook-lifecycle services, PostgreSQL schemas and end-to-end system tests for the Pelion Machine Learning platform.
Used Kubernetes persistent storage backed by AWS EFS for Jupyter notebooks; developed related web services and sensor-data applications with React, Node.js/Express and PostgreSQL.
Arm — Graduate Software Engineer | Austin, TX | January 2019–April 2020
Built FPGA master/slave Verilog test modules and C++ Mbed OS firmware for embedded-board I/O qualification as part of the Mbed OS FPGA CI Test Shield.
**The University of Texas at Austin** — B.S. Electrical and Computer Engineering, December 2018. Focus: Computer Architecture and Embedded Systems; Integrated Circuits.
EDA, SoC interconnects, Python, Linux, LSF, TypeScript/Angular, Jenkins, Playwright, Git, CI/CD, C++, Verilog, embedded systems, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL.
